packageRules.description: Keep pinned third-party source snapshots under explicit upstream review
Wait 7 days before taking a new action release (supply-chain cooldown).

gtk4-session-lock 0.5 needs gtk4-layer-shell >= 1.2 (pkg-config), but CI builds layer-shell v1.1.1 (scripts/ci-install-gtk4-layer-shell). Hold the crate until that pinned build moves to >= 1.2 (#1299).
